## What the diff compares

`scanned_at`, `loom_version`, `laravel_version` and `stats` are ignored. Entries match by identity:

| Section | Matched by |
| --- | --- |
| events, listeners, jobs, mailables, notifications | `fqcn` |
| observers | `fqcn` and `observes` |
| model_events | `id` |
| scheduled_tasks | `file`, `line`, `kind`, `target` |
| unresolved_dispatches | `file`, `line`, `expression` |
| closure_listeners | `file`, `line`, `event`, `registration` |

Cross-link arrays such as `handled_by` and `dispatches` compare by membership: a member is added or removed, never edited.

Reordering `notifications.channels` counts as a change. Closure listeners are only added or removed.

# GitHub Action reference

The Loom composite action scans your branch, runs `loom:check`, diffs against the pull request's base branch and posts one sticky comment. The walkthrough is [Gate your CI](../guides/gate-your-ci.md).

```yaml
name: Loom
on: pull_request

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  loom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: lucasp1337/laravel-loom@v0.4.0
```

Your app must require `lucasp1337/laravel-loom` as a dev dependency: the action runs `composer install`, then `php artisan loom:scan`.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Effect | Consequence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `php-version` | `8.3` | PHP version installed, with `dom`, `mbstring` and `xml`. | Must satisfy your app's `composer.json`. |
| `laravel-version` | empty | Laravel version to report. Empty reads it from `composer.lock`. | Informational only. |
| `strict` | `false` | Runs `loom:check --strict`. | Left off, unresolved dispatches are never checked. |
| `comment-on-pr` | `true` | Posts or updates a sticky PR comment with the check result and diff. | Needs `pull-requests: write`. Does nothing outside `pull_request` events. |
| `fail-on-diff` | `false` | Fails the build when the diff reports changes. | Every PR that touches architecture goes red. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory holding `artisan` and `composer.json`. | In a subdirectory the base-branch diff is skipped. |

## Outputs

| Output | Value | Watch for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index-path` | Absolute path to the `index.json` the scan wrote. | Use it in later steps, such as `loom:check --baseline`. |
| `unresolved-count` | Number of unresolved-dispatch violations from `loom:check`. | Always `0` unless `strict` is `true`: the action never passes a baseline. |
| `diff-summary` | One line about the diff. | Empty outside `pull_request` events. |

`diff-summary` is one of:

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `No architectural changes vs <base>.` | The diff exited `0`. |
| `Architectural changes detected vs <base>.` | The diff exited `1`. The full diff is in the PR comment. |
| `loom:diff failed (exit N).` | Input error. The build isn't failed for it. |
| `Diff skipped (no base index could be built).` | The base branch couldn't be scanned. |

## What fails the build

| Condition | Build |
| --- | --- |
| `loom:check` exits `1` (policy violation) | Fails with exit `1`. |
| `loom:check` exits `2` (couldn't run) | Fails with exit `2`. |
| Diff finds changes, `fail-on-diff` is `false` | Passes. |
| Diff finds changes, `fail-on-diff` is `true` | Fails with exit `1`. |
| Diff skipped or errored | Passes, whatever `fail-on-diff` says. |

Without `strict`, `unresolved-dispatches` checks nothing; the other [rules](check-rules-and-formats.md#rules) always run.

!!! warning "A missing diff is not a clean diff"
    The base index is built by installing and scanning the base branch in a temporary worktree. If that fails, as on the first PR that adds Loom, the diff is skipped and the build passes.

## Permissions

| Permission | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `contents: read` | Checkout and the base-branch fetch. |
| `pull-requests: write` | Posting and updating the comment. |

!!! warning "Fork PRs can't comment"
    On fork PRs `GITHUB_TOKEN` is read-only, so the comment step fails the job. Set `comment-on-pr: "false"` there and read the job log.

## What the comment contains

The comment holds the diff summary, the [markdown output](check-rules-and-formats.md#markdown) of `loom:check`, and any diff in a collapsed block. Later pushes edit it in place.

# MCP tools

Every tool `php artisan loom:mcp` serves, with its inputs, a real response and its errors. To register the server, read [Ask an agent](../guides/ask-an-agent.md).

```bash
php artisan loom:mcp --no-scan
```

All tools are read-only and return one JSON document as text. Renaming or removing a tool, input or output key is a major change; adding an optional one is minor.

The responses below come from a small order app: `POST /orders` fires `OrderPlaced`; `SendReceipt` handles it, fires `ReceiptSent` and queues `SendMail`; `ArchiveReceipt` and a closure handle `ReceiptSent`, and the closure fires `ReceiptLogged`. `OrderCancelled` is unused and `AuditOrders` handles no event.

## Which tool answers what

| Tool | Answers | Inputs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`list-entities`](#list-entities) | What did the scan find in one section? | `section` |
| [`get-entity`](#get-entity) | What is the full record for one class? | `kind`, `fqcn` |
| [`dispatch-sites-for`](#dispatch-sites-for) | Where is this event fired? | `event_fqcn` |
| [`handlers-for`](#handlers-for) | Who handles this event? | `event_fqcn` |
| [`dispatches-from`](#dispatches-from) | What does this method fire directly? | `method_fqcn` |
| [`events-following`](#events-following) | What does this event set off, transitively? | `event_fqcn`, `depth` |
| [`events-from-method`](#events-from-method) | What does this method set off, transitively? | `method_fqcn`, `depth` |
| [`route-to-events`](#route-to-events) | What does this HTTP route set off? | `method`, `uri`, `depth` |
| [`impact-of-change`](#impact-of-change) | What does removing or renaming this class affect? | `fqcn`, `change` |
| [`find-orphans`](#find-orphans) | Which events and listeners are dead weight? | none |
| [`find-unresolved-dispatches`](#find-unresolved-dispatches) | Which dispatches could Loom not resolve? | none |

## Conventions

- Class names are fully qualified and case-sensitive (`App\Events\OrderPlaced`); JSON escapes the backslashes.
- `depth` counts handler-to-dispatch hops, default `3`. Values outside `1` to `6` are clamped, not rejected, and the response echoes the depth used.
- `method_fqcn` is `Class::method`, `Class@method`, or a bare `Class` for every method it has.
- A handler is `Class::method` for a listener and `file:line` for a closure; `handler_kind` is `listener` or `closure` accordingly.
- Errors come back as text, not JSON. An empty result is not an error unless a tool says so.

### Chain output

`events-following`, `events-from-method`, `route-to-events` and `impact-of-change` embed the same chain, with:

- `truncated`: `true` when `depth` cut a chain short.
- `cycles`: events revisited on a path; each event is expanded once.
- `events_reached`: the events whose handlers were expanded.

## Lookups

Find a class or list a section of the index.

### `list-entities`

Lists one section of the index verbatim, with a count. Use it to find a class name before asking about it.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `section` | string | required | The index section to list. One of `events`, `listeners`, `observers`, `model_events`, `jobs`, `unresolved_dispatches`, `closure_listeners`, `scheduled_tasks`, `mailables`, `notifications`, `routes`, `unresolved_routes`. |

Called with `section` = `jobs`, it returns:

```json
{
  "section": "jobs",
  "count": 1,
  "items": [
    {
      "fqcn": "App\\Jobs\\SendMail",
      "file": "app/Jobs/SendMail.php",
      "line": 7,
      "queued": true,
      "queue_config": {
        "connection": null,
        "queue": null,
        "delay": null,
        "tries": null,
        "timeout": null,
        "backoff": null,
        "after_commit": null
      },
      "dispatched_from": [
        {
          "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
          "line": 14,
          "method": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt::handle"
        }
      ],
      "dispatches": []
    }
  ]
}
```

- `items` are the entries of that section of the [index](schema.md), unchanged.

Errors come back as a text message instead of JSON:

| Called with | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `section` = `widgets` | `Unknown section [widgets]; expected one of: events, listeners, observers, model_events, jobs, unresolved_dispatches, closure_listeners, scheduled_tasks, mailables, notifications, routes, unresolved_routes.` |

### `get-entity`

Fetches one class's record by kind and fully qualified name.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string | required | The kind of entity to fetch. One of `event`, `listener`, `observer`, `job`, `mailable`, `notification`. |
| `fqcn` | string | required | The fully-qualified class name of the entity. |

Called with `kind` = `listener`, `fqcn` = `App\Listeners\SendReceipt`, it returns:

```json
{
  "kind": "listener",
  "fqcn": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt",
  "found": true,
  "entity": {
    "fqcn": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt",
    "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
    "line": 9,
    "handles": [
      {
        "event": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
        "method": "handle"
      }
    ],
    "registration": "discovery_unverified",
    "queued": false,
    "dispatches": [
      {
        "target": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
        "kind": "event",
        "confidence": "high",
        "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
        "line": 13
      },
      {
        "target": "App\\Jobs\\SendMail",
        "kind": "job",
        "confidence": "high",
        "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
        "line": 14
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

- `entity` is the raw index entry, the same one `list-entities` and `index.json` carry.

Errors come back as a text message instead of JSON:

| Called with | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `kind` = `job`, `fqcn` = `App\Nope` | `No job found for App\Nope.` |
| `kind` = `route`, `fqcn` = `x` | `Unknown kind [route]; expected one of: event, listener, observer, job, mailable, notification.` |

## Edges

One hop, no recursion.

### `dispatch-sites-for`

Lists every place that dispatches the event: the file, the line and the method that contains the call.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event_fqcn` | string | required | Fully-qualified event class name, e.g. App\Events\OrderPlaced. |

Called with `event_fqcn` = `App\Events\OrderPlaced`, it returns:

```json
{
  "event": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
  "count": 1,
  "dispatch_sites": [
    {
      "file": "app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php",
      "line": 11,
      "method": "App\\Http\\Controllers\\OrderController::store"
    }
  ]
}
```

- An event nothing fires returns `count` `0` and an empty list, not an error.

Errors come back as a text message instead of JSON:

| Called with | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `event_fqcn` = `""` | `event_fqcn is required.` |

### `handlers-for`

Lists the listeners and the closure listeners bound to an event.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event_fqcn` | string | required | Fully-qualified event class name, e.g. App\Events\OrderPlaced. |

Called with `event_fqcn` = `App\Events\ReceiptSent`, it returns:

```json
{
  "event": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
  "count": 2,
  "listeners": [
    {
      "listener": "App\\Listeners\\ArchiveReceipt",
      "method": "handle",
      "queued": false
    }
  ],
  "closure_listeners": [
    {
      "file": "app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php",
      "line": 14,
      "queued": false
    }
  ]
}
```

- `count` is listeners plus closure listeners.
- A closure listener has no class name, so it is identified by `file` and `line`.

Errors come back as a text message instead of JSON:

| Called with | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `event_fqcn` = `""` | `event_fqcn is required.` |

### `dispatches-from`

Lists the events and jobs one method dispatches, with the file and line of each call.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method_fqcn` | string | required | Method reference: Class::method, Class@method, or a bare Class for every method, e.g. App\Http\Controllers\OrderController::store. |

Called with `method_fqcn` = `App\Http\Controllers\OrderController::store`, it returns:

```json
{
  "method_fqcn": "App\\Http\\Controllers\\OrderController::store",
  "count": 1,
  "dispatches": [
    {
      "target": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
      "kind": "event",
      "confidence": "high",
      "file": "app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php",
      "line": 11
    }
  ]
}
```

- Only routes resolve to an exact method. For a listener, observer or job the answer covers the whole class.

Errors come back as a text message instead of JSON:

| Called with | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `method_fqcn` = `""` | `method_fqcn is required.` |

## Chains

Follow dispatches transitively, down to `depth` hops.

### `events-following`

Follows an event to its handlers, what they dispatch, and the handlers of those events, down to `depth` hops.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event_fqcn` | string | required | The fully-qualified class name of the event to follow. |
| `depth` | integer | `3` | How many handler→dispatch hops to follow (clamped to 1..6). |

Called with `event_fqcn` = `App\Events\OrderPlaced`, it returns:

```json
{
  "root": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
  "depth": 3,
  "edges": [
    {
      "event": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
      "handler": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt::handle",
      "handler_kind": "listener",
      "dispatches": [
        {
          "target": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
          "kind": "event",
          "confidence": "high",
          "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
          "line": 13
        },
        {
          "target": "App\\Jobs\\SendMail",
          "kind": "job",
          "confidence": "high",
          "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
          "line": 14
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "event": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
      "handler": "App\\Listeners\\ArchiveReceipt::handle",
      "handler_kind": "listener",
      "dispatches": []
    },
    {
      "event": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
      "handler": "app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php:14",
      "handler_kind": "closure",
      "dispatches": [
        {
          "target": "App\\Events\\ReceiptLogged",
          "kind": "event",
          "confidence": "high",
          "file": "app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php",
          "line": 15
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "event": "App\\Events\\ReceiptLogged",
      "handler": "App\\Listeners\\WriteAuditLog::handle",
      "handler_kind": "listener",
      "dispatches": []
    }
  ],
  "events_reached": [
    "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
    "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
    "App\\Events\\ReceiptLogged"
  ],
  "cycles": [],
  "truncated": false
}
```

- Each edge is one handler of one event.
- An event that is not in the index returns an empty `edges` list, not an error.
- See [Chain output](#chain-output) for `truncated`, `cycles` and `events_reached`.

### `events-from-method`

Starts from a method: what it dispatches, then the chain that follows each dispatched event.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method_fqcn` | string | required | The method to start from, e.g. App\Http\Controllers\OrderController::store. |
| `depth` | integer | `3` | How many handler→dispatch hops to follow per chain (clamped to 1..6). |

Called with `method_fqcn` = `App\Http\Controllers\OrderController::store`, `depth` = `1`, it returns:

```json
{
  "method_fqcn": "App\\Http\\Controllers\\OrderController::store",
  "dispatches": [
    {
      "target": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
      "kind": "event",
      "confidence": "high",
      "file": "app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php",
      "line": 11
    }
  ],
  "chains": [
    {
      "root": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
      "depth": 1,
      "edges": [
        {
          "event": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
          "handler": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt::handle",
          "handler_kind": "listener",
          "dispatches": [
            {
              "target": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
              "kind": "event",
              "confidence": "high",
              "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
              "line": 13
            },
            {
              "target": "App\\Jobs\\SendMail",
              "kind": "job",
              "confidence": "high",
              "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
              "line": 14
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "events_reached": [
        "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced"
      ],
      "cycles": [],
      "truncated": true
    }
  ]
}
```

- `dispatches` is what `dispatches-from` returns; `chains` holds one `events-following` result per dispatched event.
- This call used `depth` `1`, so `truncated` is `true`: the chain stops before the handlers of `ReceiptSent`.
- An unknown method returns empty `dispatches` and `chains`.
- Method granularity is exact only for routes; a listener, observer or job resolves at class level.

### `route-to-events`

Resolves a route to its controller method, then behaves like `events-from-method`. The verb is case-insensitive; the URI is matched exactly, with or without a leading slash.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | string | required | The HTTP verb, e.g. GET or POST (case-insensitive). |
| `uri` | string | required | The route URI, e.g. orders or /orders (leading slash optional). |
| `depth` | integer | `3` | How many handler→dispatch hops to follow per chain (clamped to 1..6). |

Called with `method` = `POST`, `uri` = `/orders`, `depth` = `1`, it returns:

```json
{
  "route": {
    "method": "POST",
    "uri": "/orders",
    "name": "orders.store",
    "controller_fqcn": "App\\Http\\Controllers\\OrderController",
    "controller_method": "store",
    "middleware": [
      "auth"
    ],
    "file": "routes/web.php",
    "line": 6
  },
  "note": null,
  "chain": {
    "method_fqcn": "App\\Http\\Controllers\\OrderController::store",
    "dispatches": [
      {
        "target": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
        "kind": "event",
        "confidence": "high",
        "file": "app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php",
        "line": 11
      }
    ],
    "chains": [
      {
        "root": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
        "depth": 1,
        "edges": [
          {
            "event": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
            "handler": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt::handle",
            "handler_kind": "listener",
            "dispatches": [
              {
                "target": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
                "kind": "event",
                "confidence": "high",
                "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
                "line": 13
              },
              {
                "target": "App\\Jobs\\SendMail",
                "kind": "job",
                "confidence": "high",
                "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
                "line": 14
              }
            ]
          }
        ],
        "events_reached": [
          "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced"
        ],
        "cycles": [],
        "truncated": true
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

A closure route has no controller method to follow, so `chain` is `null` and `note` says why. Called with `method` = `GET`, `uri` = `/health`, it returns:

```json
{
  "route": {
    "method": "GET",
    "uri": "/health",
    "name": null,
    "controller_fqcn": null,
    "controller_method": null,
    "middleware": [],
    "file": "routes/web.php",
    "line": 8
  },
  "note": "Route has no resolved controller (closure or unresolved action); no event chain available.",
  "chain": null
}
```

- `chain` holds what `events-from-method` returns.
- `note` is always present: `null` when `chain` resolved, a sentence when it did not.

Errors come back as a text message instead of JSON:

| Called with | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `method` = `DELETE`, `uri` = `nope` | `No route found for DELETE nope.` |

## Analysis

Review questions over the whole graph.

### `impact-of-change`

Reports what removing or renaming an event, listener or job touches. `change` only changes the wording of `notes`.

| Input | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fqcn` | string | required | The fully-qualified class name being changed (event, listener, or job). |
| `change` | string | `remove` | The kind of change being made. Affects the framing of the notes only. One of `remove`, `rename`. |

Called with `fqcn` = `App\Listeners\SendReceipt`, it returns:

```json
{
  "fqcn": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt",
  "change": "remove",
  "kind": "listener",
  "handles": [
    "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced"
  ],
  "would_orphan_events": [
    "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced"
  ],
  "dispatches": [
    {
      "target": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
      "kind": "event",
      "confidence": "high",
      "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
      "line": 13
    },
    {
      "target": "App\\Jobs\\SendMail",
      "kind": "job",
      "confidence": "high",
      "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
      "line": 14
    }
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Removing this class would leave 1 event with no remaining handler: App\\Events\\OrderPlaced.",
    "Downstream dispatches from this class are listed; their own chains are not expanded here."
  ]
}
```

For an event the report lists who fires it, who handles it, and the chain downstream. Called with `fqcn` = `App\Events\OrderPlaced`, it returns:

```json
{
  "fqcn": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
  "change": "remove",
  "kind": "event",
  "dispatchers": [
    {
      "file": "app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php",
      "line": 11,
      "method": "App\\Http\\Controllers\\OrderController::store"
    }
  ],
  "handlers": [
    {
      "handler": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt::handle",
      "handler_kind": "listener"
    }
  ],
  "downstream": {
    "root": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
    "depth": 3,
    "edges": [
      {
        "event": "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
        "handler": "App\\Listeners\\SendReceipt::handle",
        "handler_kind": "listener",
        "dispatches": [
          {
            "target": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
            "kind": "event",
            "confidence": "high",
            "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
            "line": 13
          },
          {
            "target": "App\\Jobs\\SendMail",
            "kind": "job",
            "confidence": "high",
            "file": "app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php",
            "line": 14
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "event": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
        "handler": "App\\Listeners\\ArchiveReceipt::handle",
        "handler_kind": "listener",
        "dispatches": []
      },
      {
        "event": "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
        "handler": "app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php:14",
        "handler_kind": "closure",
        "dispatches": [
          {
            "target": "App\\Events\\ReceiptLogged",
            "kind": "event",
            "confidence": "high",
            "file": "app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php",
            "line": 15
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "event": "App\\Events\\ReceiptLogged",
        "handler": "App\\Listeners\\WriteAuditLog::handle",
        "handler_kind": "listener",
        "dispatches": []
      }
    ],
    "events_reached": [
      "App\\Events\\OrderPlaced",
      "App\\Events\\ReceiptSent",
      "App\\Events\\ReceiptLogged"
    ],
    "cycles": [],
    "truncated": false
  },
  "notes": [
    "Removing this event orphans its 1 handler; its 1 dispatch site would dispatch a missing class.",
    "Dynamic dispatches (event($var), string class names) are not statically resolvable and may not appear here."
  ]
}
```

A class Loom does not know gets `kind` `unknown` and a note instead of a chain. Called with `fqcn` = `App\Nope`, it returns:

```json
{
  "fqcn": "App\\Nope",
  "change": "remove",
  "kind": "unknown",
  "dispatchers": [],
  "handlers": [],
  "downstream": null,
  "notes": [
    "No event, listener, or job in the index matches this FQCN. It may be unscanned, dynamically referenced, or misspelled."
  ]
}
```

- For a listener, `handles` are the events it handles and `would_orphan_events` are those whose only handler it is. A job has the same keys, with empty `handles`.
- For an event, each `handlers` entry is `{ handler, handler_kind }`, named like a chain edge.
- `notes` call out what static analysis cannot determine, such as dynamic dispatches.

Errors come back as a text message instead of JSON:

| Called with | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `fqcn` = `App\Events\OrderPlaced`, `change` = `explode` | `Unknown change [explode]; expected one of: remove, rename.` |

### `find-orphans`

Lists events that nothing fires and nothing handles, and listeners that handle no event.

Takes no input.

Called with no input, it returns:

```json
{
  "orphan_events": [
    {
      "fqcn": "App\\Events\\OrderCancelled",
      "kind": "class",
      "file": "app/Events/OrderCancelled.php",
      "line": 5
    }
  ],
  "idle_listeners": [
    {
      "fqcn": "App\\Listeners\\AuditOrders",
      "file": "app/Listeners/AuditOrders.php",
      "line": 5
    }
  ]
}
```

- An event fired only from a dispatch Loom could not resolve can look orphaned. Cross-check with `find-unresolved-dispatches`.

### `find-unresolved-dispatches`

Lists every dispatch Loom could not trace to a class, with the raw expression and a reason code.

Takes no input.

Called with no input, it returns:

```json
{
  "count": 1,
  "unresolved_dispatches": [
    {
      "file": "app/Jobs/SendMail.php",
      "line": 13,
      "expression": "event($this->followUp)",
      "reason": "stored_target"
    }
  ]
}
```

- Each `reason` links to the code that produces it in [What Loom detects](detection/index.md#unresolved-reasons).

# Schema

Reference for `storage/loom/index.json`, generated from `schema/loom-index.schema.json`.

```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "loom_version": "0.4.0",
  "scanned_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "laravel_version": "13.0",
  "stats": {"events":4,"model_events":0,"listeners":4,"observers":0,"jobs":1,"unresolved_dispatches":1,"closure_listeners":1,"scheduled_tasks":0,"routes":2,"unresolved_routes":0,"mailables":0,"notifications":0},
  "events": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "model_events": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "listeners": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "observers": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "jobs": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "unresolved_dispatches": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "closure_listeners": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "scheduled_tasks": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "routes": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "unresolved_routes": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "mailables": [ { "...": "..." } ],
  "notifications": [ { "...": "..." } ]
}
```

- Every top-level field is required; arrays may be empty but never `null`. A trailing `?` marks an optional field.
- The schema rejects unknown top-level keys; the [PHP API](php-api.md) ignores them.
- `file` is a [relative, forward-slashed path](#relativepath) and `line` is 1-indexed.
- `dispatched_from`, `handled_by`, `dispatches`, `sent_from` and `notified_from` are joined across sections after the scan, and empty when nothing matches.

## Top-level fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | string | Version of this document shape, `MAJOR.MINOR`, which consumers key on. |
| `loom_version` | string | Semver of the Loom package that wrote the file, for information only. |
| `scanned_at` | string | ISO 8601 UTC timestamp ending in `Z`, the only field that differs between two scans of identical source. |
| `laravel_version` | string | Laravel version detected in the scanned app. |
| `stats` | object | One integer count per section, keyed by section name; always mirrors the array sizes. |
| `events` | array of [`events[]`](#events) | Event classes, where each is fired and which listeners handle it. |
| `model_events` | array of [`model_events[]`](#model_events) | Eloquent model events with the observers and `Event::listen` calls that handle them. |
| `listeners` | array of [`listeners[]`](#listeners) | Listener classes, the events they handle and what they dispatch. |
| `observers` | array of [`observers[]`](#observers) | Observer classes, the model each one observes and the hooks it implements. |
| `jobs` | array of [`jobs[]`](#jobs) | Job classes with their queue settings, where they are dispatched and what they dispatch. |
| `unresolved_dispatches` | array of [`unresolved_dispatches[]`](#unresolved_dispatches) | Dispatch calls whose target could not be resolved statically. |
| `closure_listeners` | array of [`closure_listeners[]`](#closure_listeners) | Closure and arrow-function listener registrations. |
| `scheduled_tasks` | array of [`scheduled_tasks[]`](#scheduled_tasks) | Task-scheduler entries. |
| `routes` | array of [`routes[]`](#routes) | HTTP routes with their middleware and the dispatches their action makes. |
| `unresolved_routes` | array of [`unresolved_routes[]`](#unresolved_routes) | Route forms that could not be read in full: macros, non-literal URIs, middleware or group attributes, unfollowed route files, attribute routes. |
| `mailables` | array of [`mailables[]`](#mailables) | Mailable classes and where they are sent from. |
| `notifications` | array of [`notifications[]`](#notifications) | Notification classes, their channels and where they are sent from. |

## `events[]`

Event classes.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Canonical identifier; the FQCN for class events. |
| `fqcn` | string | Fully qualified class name. |
| `kind` | one of `class` | Only `class` today. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File declaring the class. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed declaration line. |
| `dispatched_from` | array of [dispatchSite](#dispatchsite) | Dispatch sites that fire this event. |
| `handled_by` | array of object | Listeners from `listeners[].handles` that handle this event, one per listener and method; closure listeners are not included. |

### `events[].handled_by[]`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listener` | string | Listener FQCN. |
| `method` | string | Handler method on the listener. |

## `model_events[]`

Synthetic Eloquent model events from observer hooks and `Event::listen('eloquent.*')` strings.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | `eloquent.{event}: {model FQCN}`. |
| `kind` | one of `model_event` | Always `model_event`. |
| `model` | string | FQCN of the model. |
| `event` | [enum](#model_eventsevent) | Eloquent hook name; `booting` and `booted` come only from `Event::listen('eloquent.booted: ...')` strings. |
| `handled_by` | array of object | Observers and `Event::listen` targets that handle this model event, deduplicated. |

### `model_events[].event`

`retrieved`, `creating`, `created`, `updating`, `updated`, `saving`, `saved`, `deleting`, `deleted`, `restoring`, `restored`, `replicating`, `trashed`, `forceDeleting`, `forceDeleted`, `booting`, `booted`.

### `model_events[].handled_by[]`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `handler` | string | FQCN of the observer, `Event::listen` target or hook callback class, or of the model for a closure model hook. |
| `method` | string | Observer hook or listener method, or `{closure}` for a closure model hook whose body is the `closure_listeners[]` entry at the same file and line. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | Observer class file, or the file holding the `Event::listen` call or model hook registration. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | Observer class line, or the `Event::listen` call line. |

## `listeners[]`

Listener classes. Handler methods include inherited ones.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fqcn` | string | Fully qualified class name. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File declaring the class. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed declaration line. |
| `handles` | array of object | Events this listener handles, deduplicated by `event`, `method` and sorted by `event`, then `method`. |
| `registration` | [enum](#listenersregistration) | How the listener was registered; when several registrations find it, the first value in the list wins. |
| `queued` | boolean | `true` when the class implements `ShouldQueue` directly or through a parent class or interface, not through a trait. |
| `dispatches` | array of [dispatch](#dispatch) | Events and jobs dispatched from the listener's handler methods. |

### `listeners[].registration`

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `subscriber` | Inside a subscriber's `subscribe()`, as a return-array value or an `$events->listen()` call. |
| `listen_array` | An entry of `$listen`. |
| `event_listen_call` | An `Event::listen()` call. |
| `auto_discovered` | A typed `handle()` under a discovery directory, with event discovery verified on; class listeners only. |
| `discovery_unverified` | The same, but whether the app runs event discovery could not be read; class listeners only. |
| `model_hook` | A closure passed to a model's static hook registrar such as `static::creating(fn ...)`; closure listeners only. |

### `listeners[].handles[]`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | string | FQCN of the event class. |
| `method` | string | Handler method, `handle` when the registration names none (auto-discovery, a bare `Listener::class`). |

## `observers[]`

Observer classes. One observer registered against N models gives N entries; when a pair is found through both paths, `attribute` wins over `observe_call`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fqcn` | string | Fully qualified class name. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File declaring the class. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed declaration line. |
| `observes` | string | FQCN of the observed model. |
| `registration` | [enum](#observersregistration) | How the observer was registered. |
| `hooks` | array of [enum](#observershooks) | Observable model events the observer has a method for, sorted. |
| `dispatches` | array of [dispatch](#dispatch) | Dispatches made from the observer's hook methods. |

### `observers[].registration`

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `observe_call` | `Model::observe(Observer::class)`, including `static::observe()` in `booted()`. |
| `attribute` | An `#[ObservedBy]` attribute on the model. |

### `observers[].hooks`

Same values as [`model_events[].event`](#model_eventsevent) without `booting`, `booted`.

## `jobs[]`

Job classes.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fqcn` | string | Fully qualified class name. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File declaring the class. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed declaration line. |
| `queued` | boolean | `true` when the class implements `ShouldQueue` directly or through a parent class or interface, not through a trait. |
| `queue_config` | [queueConfig](#queueconfig) or null | `null` when `queued` is `false`. |
| `dispatched_from` | array of [dispatchSite](#dispatchsite) | Dispatch sites whose resolved kind is `job` and whose target is this class. |
| `dispatches` | array of [dispatch](#dispatch) | Dispatches made from the job's `handle` method. |

## `unresolved_dispatches[]`

Dispatch sites and listener or model-hook registrations that could not be resolved statically. Never dropped silently.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File containing the unresolved dispatch. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed line of the unresolved dispatch. |
| `expression` | string | Pretty-printed source of the unresolvable expression. |
| `reason` | [enum](#unresolved_dispatchesreason) | Why the dispatch or registration could not be resolved. |

### `unresolved_dispatches[].reason`

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `dynamic_class_name` | The target is a variable, or `new $class` / `$class::dispatch()`. |
| `dynamic_method_name` | A dispatching facade called with a variable method name (`Bus::$method($job)`), so the call it makes is unknown. |
| `container_resolution` | The target comes from `app()`, `resolve()` or `->make()`. |
| `string_concatenation` | The target is built by concatenation or interpolation. |
| `conditional_dispatch` | A ternary or `match` whose branches cannot be evaluated. |
| `dynamic_list` | A list of dispatch targets built at runtime (a variable, a spread, a collection). |
| `string_event_name` | The event is a string literal such as `'service.installed'`, not a class. |
| `closure_job` | A closure is dispatched as a job, so no class names it. |
| `view_mail` | A mail built from a view, an array, raw text or HTML (`Mail::send('view', ...)`, `Mail::raw()`), so there is no mailable class. |
| `call_result` | The target is what a method, static or function call returns. |
| `stored_target` | The target is read from a property, an array element or a constant. |
| `relative_class_name` | `self`, `static` or `parent` in a trait or anonymous class, or `parent` with no parent: there is no class name to read. |
| `unsupported_expression` | An expression form no other reason covers (a `??` coalesce, an anonymous class). |
| `class_not_found` | The target is a class name, but no file declaring it exists in the scanned directories (a vendor class, a missing file, an excluded path); `expression` is `Fqcn::class`. |
| `target_not_indexed` | A class file was found, but it is not an indexed event, job, mailable or notification. |
| `unreadable_event_name` | A registration whose event name or key is not a `::class` reference or a literal Loom can read (a variable, a call, an `eloquent.*` name with an unknown hook). |
| `untyped_closure_listener` | An `Event::listen(function ($e) {...})` closure whose first parameter has no event class type. |
| `unreadable_listener` | A listener registration (`$listen`, `Event::listen()`, a subscriber return array) whose handler is not a class reference, a `[Class, method]` tuple, a readable string or a closure. |
| `unreadable_subscriber` | An `Event::subscribe()` call or `$subscribe` entry that is not a `::class` reference, a string literal or `new`. |
| `unreadable_model_hook` | A `static::creating(...)` style hook whose callback is not a closure or readable callable. |

## `closure_listeners[]`

Closure and arrow-function registrations, one entry per site, never joined into `events[].handled_by`. Not deduplicated. Dispatches inside `[line, end_line]` of the file belong to it, nested closures included. Filter by `event` to find the closures for an event.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | string | FQCN for `::class` registrations, else the raw event string (`eloquent.{hook}: {model}` for a model hook). |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File holding the closure, not the registration call. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed first line of the closure. |
| `end_line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed last line of the closure; equals `line` for a one-line closure. |
| `registration` | [enum](#closure_listenersregistration) | How the closure was registered. |
| `queued` | boolean | Always `false`; closure queue detection is not done. |
| `dispatches` | array of [dispatch](#dispatch) | Dispatches attributed to the closure by source span. |

### `closure_listeners[].registration`

Same values as [`listeners[].registration`](#listenersregistration) without `auto_discovered`, `discovery_unverified`.

## `scheduled_tasks[]`

Scheduler entries, one per chain. Deduplicated on `file`, `line`, `kind`, `target`; kernel and bootstrap forms win over the facade form. Join a `job` target to `jobs[]` client-side.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | [enum](#scheduled_taskskind) | What the entry runs, which also decides what `target` holds. |
| `name` | string or null | The `->name()` label verbatim, or `null`. |
| `target` | string or null | Depends on `kind`; `null` for an inline closure. |
| `arguments` | array of string | For the `command` kind, the literal parameters of `->command(Class::class, [...])` as strings, keyed ones as `key=value`; otherwise `[]`. |
| `queue` | string or null | `job` kind only: the second argument of `->job($job, $queue)`. |
| `connection` | string or null | `job` kind only: the third argument of `->job($job, $queue, $connection)`. |
| `cron` | string or null | Canonical five-field expression from the last frequency helper in the chain (`daily` is `0 0 * * *`), or `null` when that helper is unrecognised or takes a variable. |
| `frequency` | object or null | Sub-minute interval from the `everySecond` to `everyThirtySeconds` helpers, else `null`; never set together with `cron`. |
| `timezone` | string or null | From `->timezone()`. |
| `without_overlapping` | boolean | `->withoutOverlapping()` appears in the chain. |
| `without_overlapping_expires_at` | integer or null | Expiry minutes from a literal `->withoutOverlapping($minutes)` argument, else `null`. |
| `on_one_server` | boolean | `->onOneServer()` appears in the chain. |
| `run_in_background` | boolean | `->runInBackground()` appears in the chain. |
| `even_in_maintenance_mode` | boolean | `->evenInMaintenanceMode()` appears in the chain. |
| `constraints` | array of string | Opaque labels for non-cron restrictions, sorted, such as `weekdays`, `between(8:00,17:00)`, `when(closure)` or `environments(production,staging)`. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File of the root call (`->command`, `->job`, `->call`, `->exec`). |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | Line of the root call, not the trailing modifier. |

### `scheduled_tasks[].kind`

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `command` | `->command()`; `target` is the signature verbatim, options included, or the command FQCN. |
| `job` | `->job()`; `target` is the job FQCN. |
| `closure` | `->call()`; `target` is `null` for an inline closure, else `Class::method`. |
| `exec` | `->exec()`; `target` is the shell string. |

### `scheduled_tasks[].frequency`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `unit` | one of `seconds` | Only `seconds` today. |
| `every` | integer ≥ 1 | Interval length in `unit`. |

## `routes[]`

HTTP routes, one per route and verb. `any()` and `redirect()` routes are reported as `ANY`; a resource `update` is reported as both `PUT` and `PATCH`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | [enum](#routesmethod) | HTTP verb, uppercase. |
| `uri` | string | Route URI with enclosing group prefixes applied; always starts with `/`, the root is `/`. |
| `name` | string or null | Group name prefix concatenated as-is with the route's own `->name()`; `null` when unnamed. |
| `controller_fqcn` | string or null | `null` for closure and non-controller routes. |
| `controller_method` | string or null | `null` for closure and non-controller routes. |
| `middleware` | array of string | Middleware names as written, in source order, including those inherited from enclosing groups, with aliases and groups not expanded. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File of the route definition. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed line of the route definition. |
| `end_line`? | integer ≥ 1 | Last line of a closure action, present only for closure actions. |
| `kind`? | [enum](#routeskind) | The router helper that registered a route with no controller of its own; omitted for every other route. |
| `dispatches` | array of [dispatch](#dispatch) | Dispatches from the controller method, or within `[line, end_line]` of the file for a closure route; empty when the controller cannot be resolved. |

### `routes[].method`

`GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `OPTIONS`, `HEAD`, `QUERY`, `ANY`.

### `routes[].kind`

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `view` | `Route::view()`. |
| `redirect` | `Route::redirect()` or `Route::permanentRedirect()`. |
| `fallback` | `Route::fallback()`. |

## `unresolved_routes[]`

Route forms Loom could not read in full. Never dropped silently.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File containing the route form. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed line of the route form. |
| `expression` | string | Pretty-printed source of the call or expression that could not be read. |
| `reason` | [enum](#unresolved_routesreason) | Why the route form could not be read in full. |

### `unresolved_routes[].reason`

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `unknown_route_call` | `Route::<name>()` is a macro or package helper; map it in `scan.route_macros`. |
| `dynamic_uri` | The URI is not a string literal; no route is emitted. |
| `dynamic_resource` | The resource name or list of resources is not literal; no route is emitted. |
| `dynamic_verbs` | The verbs of `Route::match()` are not a literal list; no route is emitted. |
| `dynamic_resource_options` | A resource option such as `only` or `names` is not literal; the defaults were used. |
| `dynamic_middleware` | A middleware or `withoutMiddleware` entry is not literal; the middleware list may be incomplete. |
| `dynamic_group_attribute` | A group or chain prefix, name, controller or middleware is not literal; routes inside may miss it. |
| `route_file_dynamic` | A route file path is not literal, so the file is not read. |
| `route_file_relative` | A route file path is relative to the working directory, so the file is not read. |
| `route_file_outside_root` | A route file path lies outside the app root, so the file is not read. |
| `route_file_not_found` | A route file path does not exist. |
| `attribute_route` | A controller declares a route with an attribute, which Loom does not read. |

## `mailables[]`

Mailable classes.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fqcn` | string | Fully qualified class name. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File declaring the class. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed declaration line. |
| `queued` | boolean | `true` when the class implements `ShouldQueue` directly or through a parent class or interface. |
| `queue_config` | [queueConfig](#queueconfig) or null | `null` when `queued` is `false`. |
| `sent_from` | array of [dispatchSite](#dispatchsite) | Dispatch sites whose resolved kind is `mailable` and whose target is this class, sorted by `file`, `line`. |

## `notifications[]`

Notification classes.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fqcn` | string | Fully qualified class name. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File declaring the class. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed declaration line. |
| `queued` | boolean | `true` when the class implements `ShouldQueue` directly or through a parent class or interface. |
| `queue_config` | [queueConfig](#queueconfig) or null | `null` when `queued` is `false`. |
| `notified_from` | array of [dispatchSite](#dispatchsite) | Dispatch sites whose resolved kind is `notification` and whose target is this class; only these may carry `channels`. |
| `channels` | array of string | Channels from `via()` in source order, as lowercased names or `Class::class` FQCNs, the union across branches and returns, or `[]` when `via()` is unreadable, missing or inherited. |
| `channels_dynamic` | boolean | `true` when `via()` exists but `channels` may differ from what a call returns, because the body is unreadable or depends on a branch or several returns. |

## Shared shapes

Referenced from several sections above.

### `relativePath`

Path relative to the app root, forward-slashed. Never absolute: a leading `/`, `\` or drive letter is rejected.

### `queueConfig`

Class-level queue settings. A key is `null` when the class declares nothing for it. The literal keeps its own type.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | string or integer or null | Literal value of the class's `$connection` property. |
| `queue` | string or integer or null | Literal value of the class's `$queue` property. |
| `delay` | string or integer or null | Literal value of the class's `$delay` property. |
| `tries` | string or integer or null | Literal value of the class's `$tries` property. |
| `timeout` | string or integer or null | Literal value of the class's `$timeout` property. |
| `backoff` | string or integer or null | Literal value of the class's `$backoff` property. |
| `after_commit` | boolean or null | Whether the class dispatches after the open database transaction commits, or `null` when the class says nothing and the queue connection's `after_commit` setting decides. |

### `dispatchSite`

One place where a class is dispatched, sent or notified from. Shared by every `dispatched_from`, `sent_from` and `notified_from` list.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File of the dispatch site. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed line of the dispatch site. |
| `method` | string | Origin of the call: `Class::method`, `VERB /uri` for a route closure, or `Class::$dispatchesEvents[hook]` for a model entry. |
| `mode`? | [enum](#dispatchsitemode) | How the call form executes, without evaluating `ShouldQueue` or the sync driver; omitted for plain forms. |
| `overrides`? | [dispatchOverrides](#dispatchoverrides) | Dispatch-time modifiers found at the call site, omitted when none. |
| `channels`? | array of string | Lowercased channel names or channel-class FQCNs from the literal filter of `Notification::send($users, $n, $channels)` or `sendNow(...)`, omitted when absent, empty or non-literal. |

#### `dispatchSite.mode`

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `sync` | Runs inline in the current process. |
| `after_response` | Runs after the HTTP response is sent. |
| `push` | Pushed straight onto a queue. |

#### Call forms by `mode`

| `mode` | Call forms |
| --- | --- |
| `sync` | `X::dispatchSync()`, `dispatch_sync()`, `Bus::dispatchSync()`, `Bus::dispatchNow()`, `Mail::sendNow()`, `Notification::sendNow()`, `->notifyNow()` |
| `after_response` | `X::dispatchAfterResponse()`, `Bus::dispatchAfterResponse()`, `->afterResponse()` on a dispatch chain |
| `push` | `Queue::push/pushOn/later/laterOn/bulk()`, `Mail::queue/onQueue/queueOn/later/laterOn()` |
| omitted | `dispatch()`, `X::dispatch()`, `Mail::send()`, `Notification::send()`, `$user->notify()` |

`->afterResponse()` and `->afterResponse(true)` give `after_response`. `->afterResponse(false)` cancels an earlier `->afterResponse()` in the same chain, and a non-literal argument is ignored.

### `dispatchOverrides`

Fluent modifiers found at the call site. Only keys that were found are present; a non-literal argument leaves its key absent.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `locale`? | string | From `->locale('es')`. |
| `mailer`? | string | From `->mailer('ses')`. |
| `connection`? | string | From `->onConnection('redis')`. |
| `queue`? | string | From `->onQueue('high')`. |
| `delay`? | integer ≥ 0 | From `->delay(60)`, integer seconds only; `now()->addMinutes(5)` and variables leave it absent. |
| `after_commit`? | boolean | From `->afterCommit()`; only ever `true`. |

### `dispatch`

A resolved dispatch made from a class method or closure.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | string | FQCN of the dispatched event, job, mailable or notification. |
| `kind` | one of `event`, `job`, `mailable`, `notification` | Whether the target is an event, a job, a mailable or a notification. |
| `confidence` | [enum](#dispatchconfidence) | How sure the scanner is of the target. |
| `file` | [path](#relativepath) | File of the dispatching call. |
| `line` | integer ≥ 1 | 1-indexed line of the dispatching call. |
| `via`? | array of string | The same-class helper methods, in call order, that lead from the handler to the call; absent when the handler makes the call itself. |

#### `dispatch.confidence`

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `high` | The target is resolved in the handler method itself. |
| `medium` | The call sits in a helper method the handler reaches (see `via`). |
| `low` | A caller passes the class to a method that dispatches `new $param` or `$param`; the site is the call. |

## Determinism

Two scans of identical source differ only in `scanned_at`. Each section is ordered by:

| Section | Order |
|---|---|
| `events`, `model_events` | `id` |
| `listeners`, `jobs`, `mailables`, `notifications` | `fqcn` |
| `observers` | `fqcn`, `observes` |
| `closure_listeners` | `event`, `file`, `line`, `end_line`, `registration` |
| `scheduled_tasks` | `file`, `line`, `kind`, `target`, `name`, `cron` |
| `routes` | `file`, `line`, `method`, `uri`, `name` |
| `unresolved_dispatches`, `unresolved_routes` | `file`, `line`, `expression`, `reason` |

Nested lists: dispatch sites by `file`, `line`, `method`, `mode`; `dispatches[]` by `file`, `line`, `target`, `kind`; `handled_by[]` by `listener` (or `handler`), `method`; `handles[]` by `event`, `method`. `middleware`, `channels` and `arguments` keep source order.

## Versioning

Key on `schema_version` (`MAJOR.MINOR`, major pinned by the schema), never on `loom_version`.

| Change | Bump |
| --- | --- |
| New optional field, new enum value, new section; required field made optional | Minor |
| New required field; optional field made required | Major |
| Field renamed, retyped or removed; enum value or section removed | Major |
| Bug fix that doesn't change shape | None |

### Reader behaviour

`IndexLoader`, `loom:check` and `loom:diff` load any minor of the same major and ignore unknown keys. A missing `schema_version` or another major is refused with a message to re-run `php artisan loom:scan`; `loom:diff` exits `2` on mixed majors.

From `1.0`, the field names, enum values and nullability on this page, and the [MCP tool](mcp-tools.md) names and inputs, follow the table above.

!!! warning "Validate with the producer's schema"
    `additionalProperties: false` makes an older copy of the schema reject a later minor.

## Open enums

These enums gain values in minor releases, so tolerate values you don't know:

- `kind` on dispatch entries
- `registration` on listeners and observers
- `reason` on `unresolved_dispatches[]`
- [`confidence`](#dispatchconfidence), ordered `high > medium > low`
- `routes[].method`
- `model_events[].event` and `observers[].hooks[]`, which follow [Eloquent's model events](https://laravel.com/docs/12.x/eloquent#events)
- `scheduled_tasks[].kind` and `scheduled_tasks[].frequency.unit`

Pin the Loom version your tooling reads, check the [changelog](https://github.com/lucasp1337/laravel-loom/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) before upgrading, and rescan after every upgrade.

# PHP API

Read a Loom index as typed objects. Each snippet runs in the test suite against a small order app; the output below it is what it printed. Fields mirror the [schema](schema.md) in camelCase.

```php
use Lucasp\Loom\Index\IndexLoader;

$index = (new IndexLoader)->fromFile('storage/loom/index.json');

echo $index->schemaVersion, "\n";
echo count($index->events()), ' events, ', count($index->routes()), " routes\n";
```

```text title="Output"
1.0
4 events, 2 routes
```

## Look up an entry

```php
$listener = $index->findListener('App\Listeners\SendReceipt');

echo "{$listener->file}:{$listener->line}\n";
echo $listener->registration->value, "\n";

var_dump($index->findListener('App\Listeners\Missing'));
```

```text title="Output"
app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php:9
discovery_unverified
NULL
```

## Walk the graph

```php
$event = 'App\Events\OrderPlaced';

foreach ($index->dispatchersOf($event) as $site) {
    echo "dispatched from {$site->method}\n";
}

foreach ($index->handlersOf($event) as $handler) {
    echo "handled by {$handler->listener}::{$handler->method}\n";

    foreach ($index->findListener($handler->listener)?->dispatches ?? [] as $dispatch) {
        echo "  dispatches {$dispatch->kind->value} {$dispatch->target}\n";
    }
}
```

```text title="Output"
dispatched from App\Http\Controllers\OrderController::store
handled by App\Listeners\SendReceipt::handle
  dispatches event App\Events\ReceiptSent
  dispatches job App\Jobs\SendMail
```

## Handle errors

```php
use Lucasp\Loom\Index\IndexLoader;
use Lucasp\Loom\Index\IndexLoadException;

try {
    (new IndexLoader)->fromJson('{"schema_version": "2.0"}');
} catch (IndexLoadException $e) {
    echo $e->getMessage(), "\n";
}
```

```text title="Output"
Loom index uses schema 2.0, newer than the supported 1.0. Upgrade laravel-loom, or re-run `php artisan loom:scan` with the installed version.
```

## Public classes

Only these classes carry `@api`; everything else is `@internal` and may change in any release.

### `Lucasp\Loom\Index`

| Class | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `Confidence` | Resolution confidence emitted on `dispatches[*].confidence` and carried on dispatch sites: how sure the scanner is that a dispatch target was resolved correctly. |
| `DispatchKinds` | The kind of a dispatch target, on `dispatches[*].kind`. |
| `DispatchMode` | How a dispatch site executes, recorded on the optional `mode` of `$defs/dispatchSite`. |
| `FrequencyUnit` | The unit of a sub-minute scheduling frequency, emitted on `scheduled_tasks[*].frequency.unit`. |
| `Index` | Immutable Loom index and the stable, documented consumption surface. |
| `IndexLoadException` | Thrown by `IndexLoader` when a Loom index cannot be read, decoded, or structurally recognised as an index payload. |
| `IndexLoader` | Hydrates an `Index` from a Loom index JSON document, the inverse of `Index::toArray()`. |
| `ListenerRegistration` | How a listener registration was discovered, emitted on `listeners[*].registration` and `closure_listeners[*].registration`. |
| `ObserverRegistration` | How an observer registration was discovered, emitted on `observers[*].registration`. |
| `ScheduleKind` | The kind of work a scheduled entry runs, emitted on `scheduled_tasks[*].kind`: an artisan command, a queued/dispatched job, an inline closure, or a shell command via `exec()`. |

### `Lucasp\Loom\Index\Model`

| Class | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `ClosureListener` | An anonymous (closure) listener bound to an event, with its source span and what it dispatches. |
| `Dispatch` | A resolved dispatch edge: a source (listener, observer, job, route, …) dispatches `target` of a given `kind` from a source location. |
| `DispatchOverrides` | Fluent modifiers applied at a dispatch site (e.g. `->onQueue('high')`, `->delay(60)`, `->afterCommit()`). |
| `DispatchSite` | A source location that dispatches an event, sends a mailable, or notifies a notification. |
| `Event` | A discovered event class, with the sites that dispatch it and the listeners that handle it. |
| `Frequency` | A sub-minute scheduling frequency such as `everyTenSeconds`, emitted on `scheduled_tasks[*].frequency` in place of a cron expression. |
| `Handle` | An event-to-method binding declared by a class listener, emitted on `listeners[*].handles`. |
| `Handler` | A listener-and-method that handles an event, emitted on `events[*].handled_by`. |
| `Job` | A queueable/dispatchable job: its queue configuration, the sites that dispatch it, and what it dispatches in turn. |
| `Listener` | A class listener: the events/methods it handles, how it was registered, and what it dispatches. |
| `Mailable` | A mailable class: its queue configuration and the sites that send it. |
| `ModelEvent` | An Eloquent model lifecycle event (e.g. `created`, `saving`) and the observers/listeners that handle it. |
| `ModelEventHandler` | A handler (observer hook or `Event::listen` target) attached to a model event, emitted on `model_events[*].handled_by`. |
| `Notification` | A notification class: its queue configuration, the channels it sends on, and the sites that notify it. |
| `Observer` | A model observer: the model it observes, which lifecycle hooks it defines, and what it dispatches. |
| `QueueConfig` | Static queue configuration read off a queueable class (job, mailable, notification): `$connection`, `$queue`, `$delay`, `$tries`, `$timeout`, `$backoff`, and whether the class dispatches after the transaction commits. |
| `Route` | An HTTP route: its verb, URI, name, controller target, middleware, and what the action dispatches. |
| `ScheduledTask` | A scheduled task (command, job, closure, or shell exec) with its cron expression or sub-minute `frequency` and its modifiers. |
| `UnresolvedDispatch` | A dispatch site the scanner could not statically resolve to a target, with the raw expression and the reason. |
| `UnresolvedRoute` | A route form the scanner could not read in full, with the source it saw and the reason. |

# Index, UI and MCP configuration

Every key outside `scan` ([Scan configuration](scan-config.md)), with its default and environment variable. Publish the file to change keys without one:

```bash
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=loom-config
```

Keys are addressed as `loom.index_path`, `loom.ui.enabled` and so on. The UI is covered in [Browse the UI](../guides/browse-the-ui.md), the server in [Ask an agent](../guides/ask-an-agent.md).

## Index

| Key | Env variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index_path` | `LOOM_INDEX_PATH` | `null` | Where `loom:scan` writes the index and where the CLI, MCP server and UI read it. `null` means `storage/loom/index.json`. |

## Browser UI

| Key | Env variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui.enabled` | `LOOM_UI_ENABLED` | `true` | Kill switch. When `false`, no routes, pages or gate exist in any environment. The UI is also absent without `livewire/livewire`. |
| `ui.environments` | none | `['local']` | App environments that mount the UI. Elsewhere nothing is registered and the path returns 404. |
| `ui.allow_in_production` | none | `false` | Listing `production` in `ui.environments` is ignored unless this is `true`. A warning is logged when it is listed but not allowed. |
| `ui.path` | `LOOM_PATH` | `loom` | URI prefix the UI is served under. Slashes at either end are trimmed; an empty value falls back to `loom`. |
| `ui.domain` | `LOOM_DOMAIN` | `null` | Serve the UI only on this domain. `null` serves every domain. |
| `ui.middleware` | none | `['web']` | Middleware that runs before the `viewLoom` gate check, which always runs. |
| `ui.index_path` | none | `null` | Overrides `index_path` for the UI only. A non-empty value wins. |
| `ui.chain_depth` | none | `3` | Depth the chain view opens with. Clamped to 1-6; a non-integer falls back to 3. |

## MCP server

| Key | Env variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mcp.enabled` | `LOOM_MCP_ENABLED` | `true` | Turns off `loom:mcp` even when laravel/mcp is installed. |

## The viewLoom gate

The default gate allows `local` and refuses everything else with a 403. It runs only where `ui.environments` mounts the UI; elsewhere the answer is a 404. Define your own `viewLoom` gate to replace it, as in [Browse the UI](../guides/browse-the-ui.md#open-it-on-staging).

!!! warning "Route caching hides changes"
    `path`, `domain` and `middleware` are frozen by [route caching](https://laravel.com/docs/12.x/routing#route-caching); run `php artisan route:clear` after changing them.

# Scan configuration

The `scan` keys of `config/loom.php` decide what `loom:scan` reads. Publish the file to change them:

```bash
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=loom-config
```

## Keys

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scan.paths` | `['app']` | Directories `loom:scan` walks, relative to the project root. A `*` matches within one path segment (`Modules/*`). Paths outside the project root are rejected. See [How directories resolve](#how-directories-resolve). |
| `scan.route_paths` | `['routes']` | Directories holding route files, relative to the project root. `*` globs are allowed (`Modules/*/routes`). Read for `routes[]` and for dispatches inside route closures; independent of `scan.paths`. |
| `scan.discover_routes` | `true` | Also read route files loaded from a statically resolvable path: `loadRoutesFrom()`, `Route::group()` with a file path and the `withRouting()` paths in `bootstrap/app.php`. `false` reads only `scan.route_paths`; `loom:scan --no-discover-routes` does the same for one run. See [Route files](#route-files). |
| `scan.route_macros` | `[]` | Router macros that register routes, each mapped to the router method it is read as: `['softDeletableResource' => 'resource']`. Other unknown router calls are listed in `unresolved_routes`. |
| `scan.psr4_paths` | `false` | Also scan every directory in `composer.json`'s `autoload.psr-4`. `autoload-dev` is not included. |
| `scan.composer_files` | `[]` | composer.json files, as globs relative to the project root (`plugins/*/composer.json`), whose `autoload.psr-4` maps are read for class lookup and whose directories are scanned. Files listed in the root composer.json's `extra.merge-plugin.include` are read for class lookup without being listed here. |
| `scan.ast_cache_mb` | `null` | Megabytes of parsed source cached during a scan. `null` sizes it from `memory_limit` (at most 8); `0` turns the cache off. |
| `scan.exclude` | `[]` | Globs relative to the project root. A match removes the file, or everything under the matching directory, from every scanner. See [Exclude globs](#exclude-globs). |

[`loom:scan`](commands.md#loomscan) options override some keys for one run.

## How directories resolve

Convention directories (`Events/`, `Listeners/`, `Jobs/`, `Mail/`, `Notifications/`) are looked for directly under each entry of `scan.paths`; everything else is found anywhere under one. Missing directories are ignored; when the rest hold no PHP files, `loom:scan` [exits `1`](commands.md#loomscan).

| Layout | `scan.paths` |
| --- | --- |
| Default Laravel | `['app']` |
| `Modules/Billing/Events/...` | `['app', 'Modules/*']` |
| `Modules/Billing/app/Events/...` | `['app', 'Modules/*/app']` |
| `lib/Domain/Events/...` | `['lib/Domain']` |
| `Modules/Billing/routes/web.php` | nothing when a provider loads it with `loadRoutesFrom()`; otherwise `scan.route_paths`: `['routes', 'Modules/*/routes']` |

## Route files

Loom reads the files under `scan.route_paths` and, while `scan.discover_routes` is on, every file loaded by a statically resolvable path from `loadRoutesFrom()`, `Route::group()`, `withRouting()`, `withCommands()` or `require`. Paths built from literals, `__DIR__`, `dirname()`, `base_path()` and `app_path()` resolve, and a loaded file's routes inherit the group around the loading call. The [route examples](detection/routes.md) show each form. A path that can't be followed is counted in the scan summary, and `loom:scan -v` lists it with one of these reasons:

- `path is not statically resolvable`: built from a variable, method call or config value
- `relative path depends on the working directory`: no `__DIR__` or `base_path()`
- `path is outside the project root`
- `no such file`

Build the path from `__DIR__` or `base_path()` with literals, or add its directory to `scan.route_paths`.

## Locating classes

A dispatched class outside a convention directory is found through the [`autoload.psr-4`](https://getcomposer.org/doc/04-schema.md#psr-4) map in `composer.json`, or `App\` → `app/` without one. The file must be inside a scan directory and not excluded.

## Exclude globs

| Pattern | Matches |
| --- | --- |
| `app/Legacy` | The directory and everything under it |
| `app/*/Fakes/*.php` | One directory level between `app/` and `Fakes/` |
| `**/Fakes` | Any `Fakes` directory at any depth |
| `app/**/*.generated.php` | Generated files at any depth under `app/` |

`*` and `?` never cross a `/`; `**` does. Matching is case-sensitive and also applies to route files and `bootstrap/app.php`.

# What Loom detects

Each page shows the code shapes Loom reads for one primitive, and the ones it does not. Every example is scanned by the test suite, and the comment at the end of a line is what the index holds for that line:

```php
public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void {} // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.event OrderPlaced
event($name); // ✗ dynamic_class_name
```

- `→ section[key].field value`: the entry in that [index section](../schema.md) has that value. Without a key, it is the entry declared on that line.
- `✗ reason`: the line is listed in `unresolved_dispatches` or `unresolved_routes` with that reason.
- `✗ not recorded`: nothing in the index points at that line.

- [Events](events.md)
- [Listeners](listeners.md)
- [Closure listeners](closure-listeners.md)
- [Observers and model hooks](observers.md)
- [Jobs](jobs.md)
- [Dispatches](dispatches.md)
- [Mailables](mailables.md)
- [Notifications](notifications.md)
- [Schedule](schedule.md)
- [Routes](routes.md)
- [Scan scope](scope.md)

| Reason | Shown on |
| --- | --- |

| `dynamic_method_name` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `container_resolution` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `string_concatenation` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `conditional_dispatch` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `dynamic_list` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `string_event_name` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `closure_job` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `view_mail` | [Mailables](mailables.md) |
| `call_result` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `stored_target` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `relative_class_name` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `unsupported_expression` | [Events](events.md), [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `class_not_found` | [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `target_not_indexed` | [Events](events.md), [Jobs](jobs.md), [Dispatches](dispatches.md) |
| `unreadable_event_name` | [Listeners](listeners.md) |
| `untyped_closure_listener` | [Closure listeners](closure-listeners.md) |
| `unreadable_listener` | [Listeners](listeners.md) |

| `unreadable_model_hook` | [Observers and model hooks](observers.md) |
