| `dynamic_uri` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `dynamic_resource` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `dynamic_verbs` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `dynamic_resource_options` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `dynamic_middleware` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `dynamic_group_attribute` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `route_file_dynamic` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `route_file_relative` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `route_file_outside_root` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `route_file_not_found` | [Routes](routes.md) |
| `attribute_route` | [Routes](routes.md) |

# Events

??? example "Events fired with X::dispatch()"

    ```php title="app/Events/OrderCancelled.php"
    namespace App\Events;

    use Illuminate\Foundation\Events\Dispatchable;

    class OrderCancelled // → events[OrderCancelled]
    {
        use Dispatchable;
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Support/StockLow.php"
    namespace App\Support;

    use Illuminate\Foundation\Events\Dispatchable;

    class StockLow // ✗ not recorded
    {
        use Dispatchable;
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Events\OrderCancelled;
    use App\Support\StockLow;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function cancel(): void
        {
            OrderCancelled::dispatch(); // → events[OrderCancelled].dispatched_from.method OrderController::cancel
            OrderCancelled::dispatchIf(true); // → events[OrderCancelled].dispatched_from.method OrderController::cancel
            OrderCancelled::dispatchUnless(false); // → events[OrderCancelled].dispatched_from.method OrderController::cancel
            StockLow::dispatch(); // ✗ target_not_indexed
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Classes in app/Events"

    ```php title="app/Events/PaymentFailed.php"
    namespace App\Events;

    class PaymentFailed {} // → events[PaymentFailed]
    ```

    ```php title="app/Events/BillingEvent.php"
    namespace App\Events;

    abstract class BillingEvent {} // → events[BillingEvent]
    ```

??? example "Fired classes outside app/Events"

    ```php title="app/Billing/RefundIssued.php"
    namespace App\Billing;

    class RefundIssued {} // → events[RefundIssued]
    ```

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/RefundController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Billing\RefundIssued;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

    class RefundController
    {
        public function store(): void
        {
            event(new RefundIssued); // → events[RefundIssued].dispatched_from.method RefundController::store
            broadcast(new RefundIssued); // → events[RefundIssued].dispatched_from.method RefundController::store
            broadcast_if(true, new RefundIssued); // → events[RefundIssued].dispatched_from.method RefundController::store
            broadcast_unless(false, new RefundIssued); // → events[RefundIssued].dispatched_from.method RefundController::store
            Event::dispatch(new RefundIssued); // → events[RefundIssued].dispatched_from.method RefundController::store
            event(new class {}); // ✗ unsupported_expression
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "A model's $dispatchesEvents map"

    ```php title="app/Models/Invoice.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Events\InvoiceCreated;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    class Invoice extends Model
    {
        protected $dispatchesEvents = [
            'created' => InvoiceCreated::class, // → events[InvoiceCreated].dispatched_from.method Invoice::$dispatchesEvents[created]
            'deleted' => 'App\Events\InvoiceDeleted', // ✗ not recorded
        ];
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Events/InvoiceCreated.php"
    namespace App\Events;

    class InvoiceCreated {}
    ```

# Listeners

??? example "Discovered listener, typed to its event"

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;

    class SendReceipt // → listeners.registration auto_discovered
    {
        public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void {} // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.event OrderPlaced
    }
    ```

??? example "Event discovery in other directories"

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;

    return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
        ->withEvents(discover: [__DIR__.'/../app/Domain/Orders/Listeners'])
        ->create();
    ```

    ```php title="app/Domain/Orders/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Domain\Orders\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;

    class SendReceipt // → listeners.registration auto_discovered
    {
        public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Event discovery turned off"

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;

    return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
        ->withEvents(false)
        ->create();
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;

    class SendReceipt // ✗ not recorded
    {
        public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Event discovery switch Loom cannot read"

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;

    return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
        ->withEvents(discover: config('events.paths'))
        ->create();
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;

    class SendReceipt // → listeners.registration discovery_unverified
    {
        public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Listener typed to a parent event"

    ```php title="app/Events/PaymentEvent.php"
    namespace App\Events;

    abstract class PaymentEvent {} // → events[PaymentEvent].handled_by.listener ReconcileLedger
    ```

    ```php title="app/Events/PaymentFailed.php"
    namespace App\Events;

    class PaymentFailed extends PaymentEvent {} // → events[PaymentFailed].handled_by []
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/ReconcileLedger.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\PaymentEvent;

    class ReconcileLedger
    {
        public function handle(PaymentEvent $event): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Handler parameter types"

    ```php title="app/Listeners/NotifyWarehouse.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;

    class NotifyWarehouse
    {
        public function __invoke(?OrderPlaced $event): void {} // → listeners[NotifyWarehouse].handles.method __invoke
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/LogOrder.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;

    class LogOrder
    {
        public function handleOrder(OrderPlaced|OrderShipped $event): void {} // → listeners[LogOrder].handles.event OrderPlaced → listeners[LogOrder].handles.event OrderShipped
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/TrackAnything.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class TrackAnything
    {
        public function handle($event): void {} // → listeners[TrackAnything].handles []
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/CountStrings.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class CountStrings
    {
        public function handle(string $event): void {} // → listeners[CountStrings].handles []
    }
    ```

??? example "Handlers from a parent class or a trait"

    ```php title="app/Listeners/BaseOrderListener.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;

    abstract class BaseOrderListener // ✗ not recorded
    {
        public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void {}
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/ReserveStock.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class ReserveStock extends BaseOrderListener {} // → listeners.handles.event OrderPlaced
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/HandlesShipping.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderShipped;

    trait HandlesShipping // ✗ not recorded
    {
        public function onShipped(OrderShipped $event): void {}
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/EmailTracking.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class EmailTracking // → listeners.handles.method handleShipped
    {
        use HandlesShipping { onShipped as handleShipped; }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/QuietTracking.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class QuietTracking // ✗ not recorded
    {
        use HandlesShipping { onShipped as protected handleShipped; }

        public function handleNothing(): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Event discovery with a pre-configure() bootstrap"

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    $app = new Illuminate\Foundation\Application(dirname(__DIR__));

    return $app;
    ```

    ```php title="app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Providers\EventServiceProvider as ServiceProvider;

    class EventServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function shouldDiscoverEvents(): bool
        {
            return true;
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;

    class SendReceipt // → listeners.registration auto_discovered
    {
        public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "The $listen array"

    ```php title="app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use App\Listeners\AuditOrders;
    use App\Listeners\SendReceipt;
    use Closure;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Providers\EventServiceProvider as ServiceProvider;

    class EventServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        protected $listen = [
            OrderPlaced::class => [
                SendReceipt::class, // → listeners[SendReceipt].registration listen_array
                [AuditOrders::class, 'onPlaced'], // → listeners[AuditOrders].handles.method onPlaced
                'App\Listeners\AuditOrders@record', // → listeners[AuditOrders].handles.method record
            ],
            OrderShipped::class => [
                AuditOrders::class.'@onShipped', // → listeners[AuditOrders].handles.method onShipped
                AuditOrders::onArchived(...), // → listeners[AuditOrders].handles.method onArchived
                Closure::fromCallable([AuditOrders::class, 'onRefunded']), // → listeners[AuditOrders].handles.method onRefunded
            ],
            'orders.*' => [
                SendReceipt::class, // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.event orders.*
            ],
        ];
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class SendReceipt
    {
        public function handle(object $event): void {}
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/AuditOrders.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class AuditOrders
    {
        public function onPlaced(object $event): void {}

        public function record(object $event): void {}

        public function onShipped(object $event): void {}

        public static function onArchived(object $event): void {}

        public function onRefunded(object $event): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Event::listen and the events dispatcher"

    ```php title="app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use App\Listeners\SendReceipt;
    use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function boot(): void
        {
            Event::listen(OrderPlaced::class, SendReceipt::class); // → listeners[SendReceipt].registration event_listen_call
            Event::listen([OrderPlaced::class, OrderShipped::class], [SendReceipt::class, 'onAny']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onAny
            \Event::listen(OrderShipped::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'onAlias']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onAlias
            \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event::listen(OrderShipped::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'onFqcn']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onFqcn
            $this->app['events']->listen(OrderShipped::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'onContainer']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onContainer
            app(Dispatcher::class)->listen(OrderShipped::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'onHelper']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onHelper
            resolve(Dispatcher::class)->listen(OrderShipped::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'onResolve']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onResolve
            app('events')->listen(OrderShipped::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'onAppString']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onAppString
            resolve('events')->listen(OrderShipped::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'onResolveString']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onResolveString

            $events = $this->app->make(Dispatcher::class);
            $events->listen(OrderShipped::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'onVariable']); // → listeners[SendReceipt].handles.method onVariable
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class SendReceipt
    {
        public function handle(object $event): void {}

        public function onAny(object $event): void {}

        public function onAlias(object $event): void {}

        public function onFqcn(object $event): void {}

        public function onContainer(object $event): void {}

        public function onHelper(object $event): void {}

        public function onResolve(object $event): void {}

        public function onAppString(object $event): void {}

        public function onResolveString(object $event): void {}

        public function onVariable(object $event): void {}
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/OrderSubscriber.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use Illuminate\Events\Dispatcher;

    class OrderSubscriber
    {
        public function subscribe(Dispatcher $events): array
        {
            return [
                OrderPlaced::class => 'onPlaced', // → listeners[OrderSubscriber].handles.method onPlaced
            ];
        }

        public function onPlaced(OrderPlaced $event): void {}
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/ShippingSubscriber.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use Illuminate\Events\Dispatcher;

    class ShippingSubscriber
    {
        public function subscribe(Dispatcher $events): void
        {
            $events->listen(OrderShipped::class, [self::class, 'onShipped']); // → listeners[ShippingSubscriber].handles.method onShipped

            collect([OrderPlaced::class])->each(fn ($event) => $events->listen($event, [self::class, 'onAny'])); // ✗ not recorded
        }

        public function onShipped(OrderShipped $event): void {}

        public function onAny(object $event): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Registrations Loom cannot read"

    ```php title="app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Listeners\SendReceipt;
    use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function __construct(private Dispatcher $dispatcher) {}

        public function boot(Dispatcher $events, string $name, object $listener, object $subscriber): void
        {
            Event::listen($name, SendReceipt::class); // ✗ unreadable_event_name
            Event::listen(OrderPlaced::class, $listener); // ✗ unreadable_listener
            Event::listen(OrderPlaced::class, [$this, 'handle']); // ✗ unreadable_listener
            Event::listen(OrderPlaced::class, 'App\Listeners\SendReceipt::handle'); // ✗ unreadable_listener
            Event::subscribe($subscriber); // ✗ unreadable_subscriber

            $events->listen(OrderPlaced::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'fromParameter']); // ✗ not recorded
            $this->dispatcher->listen(OrderPlaced::class, [SendReceipt::class, 'fromProperty']); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class SendReceipt
    {
        public function fromParameter(object $event): void {}

        public function fromProperty(object $event): void {}
    }
    ```

# Closure listeners

??? example "Dispatches inside a closure listener"

    ```php title="app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Events\InvoiceSettled;
    use App\Events\PaymentReceived;
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function boot(): void
        {
            Event::listen(PaymentReceived::class, function ($event) { // → closure_listeners.queued false
                event(new InvoiceSettled); // → closure_listeners[PaymentReceived].dispatches.target InvoiceSettled

                collect([1, 2])->each(fn () => ProcessOrder::dispatch()); // → closure_listeners[PaymentReceived].dispatches.target ProcessOrder
            });
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Events/InvoiceSettled.php"
    class InvoiceSettled {} // → events[InvoiceSettled].dispatched_from []
    ```

??? example "Closure registrations"

    ```php title="app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Providers\EventServiceProvider as ServiceProvider;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

    class EventServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        protected $listen = [
            OrderPlaced::class => [
                fn (OrderPlaced $event) => null, // → closure_listeners.registration listen_array
            ],
            'orders.archived' => [
                function ($event) {}, // → closure_listeners.event orders.archived
            ],
        ];

        public function boot(): void
        {
            Event::listen(OrderPlaced::class, fn ($event) => null); // → closure_listeners.registration event_listen_call
            Event::listen(function (OrderShipped $event) {}); // → closure_listeners.event OrderShipped
            Event::listen(fn (OrderPlaced|OrderShipped $event) => null); // → closure_listeners.event OrderPlaced → closure_listeners.event OrderShipped
            Event::listen(fn ($event) => null); // ✗ untyped_closure_listener
            Event::listen(fn (object $event) => null); // ✗ untyped_closure_listener
            Event::subscribe(\App\Listeners\OrderSubscriber::class);
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/OrderSubscriber.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use Illuminate\Events\Dispatcher;

    class OrderSubscriber
    {
        public function subscribe(Dispatcher $events): array
        {
            return [
                OrderShipped::class => fn (OrderShipped $event) => null, // → closure_listeners.registration subscriber
            ];
        }
    }
    ```

# Observers and model hooks

??? example "eloquent.* event strings"

    ```php title="app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Listeners\AuditOrder;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Providers\EventServiceProvider as ServiceProvider;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

    class EventServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        protected $listen = [
            'eloquent.deleted: App\Models\Order' => [
                AuditOrder::class, // → model_events[eloquent.deleted: App\Models\Order].handled_by.handler AuditOrder
            ],
        ];

        public function boot(): void
        {
            Event::listen('eloquent.created: App\Models\Order', 'App\Listeners\AuditOrder@created'); // → model_events[eloquent.created: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method created
            Event::listen('eloquent.updated: App\Models\Order', [AuditOrder::class, 'updated']); // → model_events[eloquent.updated: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method updated
            Event::listen('eloquent.booted: App\Models\Order', AuditOrder::class); // → model_events[eloquent.booted: App\Models\Order].handled_by.handler AuditOrder
            Event::listen('eloquent.saved: App\Models\Order', fn ($order) => null); // → model_events[eloquent.saved: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method {closure}
            $this->app['events']->listen('eloquent.restored: App\Models\Order', AuditOrder::class); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/AuditOrder.php"

    {
        public function handle(): void {}

        public function created(): void {}

        public function updated(): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Model hook registrations"

    ```php title="app/Models/Order.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Support\OrderHooks;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    class Order extends Model
    {
        protected static function booted(): void
        {
            static::created(function (Order $order) { // → model_events[eloquent.created: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method {closure} → closure_listeners.registration model_hook
                event(new OrderPlaced); // → closure_listeners[eloquent.created: App\Models\Order].dispatches.target OrderPlaced
            });
            static::saved([OrderHooks::class, 'saved']); // → model_events[eloquent.saved: App\Models\Order].handled_by.handler OrderHooks
            static::deleted(OrderHooks::class); // → model_events[eloquent.deleted: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method handle
            static::updated('App\Support\OrderHooks@updated'); // → model_events[eloquent.updated: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method updated
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Models/Concerns/HasUuid.php"
    namespace App\Models\Concerns;

    trait HasUuid
    {
        protected static function bootHasUuid(): void
        {
            static::creating(fn ($model) => null); // → model_events[eloquent.creating: App\Models\User].handled_by.method {closure} → model_events[eloquent.creating: App\Models\Invoice].handled_by.method {closure}
        }
    }
    ```



# Jobs

??? example "Queue settings from the constructor"

    ```php title="app/Jobs/BaseJob.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;

    abstract class BaseJob
    {
        use Queueable;

        public function __construct()
        {
            $this->onConnection('sqs');
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Jobs/ShipOrder.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;

    class ShipOrder extends BaseJob implements ShouldQueue
    {
        public $queue = 'default';

        public function __construct(bool $urgent = false)
        {
            parent::__construct(); // → jobs[ShipOrder].queue_config.connection sqs
            $this->onQueue('shipping'); // → jobs[ShipOrder].queue_config.queue shipping
            $this->delay(60); // → jobs[ShipOrder].queue_config.delay 60
            $this->afterCommit(); // → jobs[ShipOrder].queue_config.after_commit true

            if ($urgent) {
                $this->onQueue('urgent');
            }
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Jobs/RestockOrder.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
    use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueueAfterCommit;

    class RestockOrder implements ShouldQueueAfterCommit
    {
        use Queueable;

        public function __construct()
        {
            $this->queue = 'restock'; // → jobs[RestockOrder].queue_config.queue restock
            $this->beforeCommit(); // → jobs[RestockOrder].queue_config.after_commit false
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/PaymentController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Actions\RefundCard;
    use App\Actions\VoidCard;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;

    class PaymentController
    {

        {
            ChargeCard::dispatch(); // → jobs[ChargeCard].dispatched_from.method PaymentController::store
            Bus::dispatch(new RefundCard); // → jobs[RefundCard].dispatched_from.method PaymentController::store
            dispatch(new RefundCard); // → jobs[RefundCard].dispatched_from.method PaymentController::store
            VoidCard::dispatch(); // ✗ target_not_indexed
        }
    }
    ```

# Dispatches

??? example "Which method a dispatch counts for"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Queue;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function store(): void
        {
            DB::transaction(fn () => event(new OrderPlaced)); // → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store

            collect([1, 2])->each(function () {
                ProcessOrder::dispatch(); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            });

            $notify = fn () => event(new OrderPlaced); // → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store

            Queue::before(fn () => event(new OrderPlaced)); // → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store

            collect([1, 2])->each($this->notify(...));
        }

        private function notify(): void
        {
            event(new OrderPlaced); // → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::notify
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/helpers.php"
    event(new \App\Events\OrderPlaced); // ✗ not recorded
    ```

??? example "Bus::chain and Bus::batch"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Jobs\ChargeOrder;
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use App\Jobs\ShipOrder;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function store(array $jobs): void
        {
            Bus::chain([new ProcessOrder, new ChargeOrder])->dispatch(); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store → jobs[ChargeOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            Bus::batch([[new ChargeOrder, new ShipOrder]])->dispatch(); // → jobs[ShipOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store

            $steps = [new ShipOrder];
            Bus::chain($steps)->dispatch(); // → jobs[ShipOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store

            Bus::chain($jobs)->dispatch(); // ✗ dynamic_list
            Bus::chain([new ChargeOrder, ...$jobs])->dispatch(); // ✗ dynamic_list → jobs[ChargeOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Jobs/ChargeOrder.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    class ChargeOrder {}
    ```

    ```php title="app/Jobs/ShipOrder.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    class ShipOrder {}
    ```

??? example "Facade calls with a variable method name"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function store(bool $sync, string $method): void
        {
            $call = 'dispatchSync';
            Bus::$call(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode sync
            Bus::{'dispatch'}(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            Bus::{'dispatchIf'}(true, new ProcessOrder); // ✗ not recorded

            Bus::$method(new ProcessOrder); // ✗ dynamic_method_name
            $mode = $sync ? 'dispatchSync' : 'dispatch';
            Bus::$mode(new ProcessOrder); // ✗ dynamic_method_name
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Dispatches reached through helper methods"

    ```php title="app/Listeners/BaseListener.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderShipped;

    abstract class BaseListener
    {
        protected function shipped(): void
        {
            event(new OrderShipped); // → events[OrderShipped].dispatched_from.method BaseListener::shipped
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use App\Support\Receipts;

    class SendReceipt extends BaseListener
    {
        public function __construct(private Receipts $receipts) {}

        public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void
        {
            ProcessOrder::dispatch(); // → listeners[SendReceipt].dispatches.confidence high
            $this->issue();
            $this->shipped();
            $this->receipts->send();
        }

        private function issue(): void
        {
            self::log();
        }

        private static function log(): void
        {
            ProcessOrder::dispatch(); // → listeners[SendReceipt].dispatches.via ["issue","log"] → listeners[SendReceipt].dispatches.confidence medium
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Support/Receipts.php"
    namespace App\Support;

    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;

    class Receipts
    {
        public function send(): void
        {
            ProcessOrder::dispatch(); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method Receipts::send
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Job dispatch calls and their mode"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Queue;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function store(): void
        {
            dispatch(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            ProcessOrder::dispatch(); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            ProcessOrder::dispatchIf(true); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            ProcessOrder::dispatchUnless(false); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            Bus::dispatch(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store

            dispatch_sync(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode sync
            ProcessOrder::dispatchSync(); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode sync
            Bus::dispatchSync(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode sync
            Bus::dispatchNow(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode sync

            ProcessOrder::dispatchAfterResponse(); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode after_response
            Bus::dispatchAfterResponse(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode after_response
            dispatch(new ProcessOrder)->afterResponse(); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode after_response

            Queue::push(new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode push
            Queue::pushOn('orders', new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode push
            Queue::later(60, new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode push
            Queue::laterOn('orders', 60, new ProcessOrder); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode push
            Queue::bulk([new ProcessOrder]); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode push
            Queue::push('App\Jobs\ProcessOrder@handle'); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.mode push
            Queue::push('App\Support\SyncInventory@fire'); // ✗ class_not_found
            Queue::pushRaw('{"job":"x"}'); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Targets held in a local variable"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function store(bool $express): void
        {
            $event = new OrderPlaced;
            event($event); // → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store

            $shipped = OrderShipped::class;
            event($shipped); // → events[OrderShipped].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store

            $next = $express ? new OrderShipped : new OrderPlaced;
            event($next); // → events[OrderShipped].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
        }

        public function update(OrderPlaced $event, bool $express): void
        {
            event($event); // ✗ dynamic_class_name

            $job = new ProcessOrder;
            if ($express) {
                $job = new ProcessOrder;
            }
            dispatch($job); // ✗ dynamic_class_name
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Chain modifiers at the dispatch"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use App\Mail\OrderReceipt;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function store(int $seconds): void
        {
            ProcessOrder::dispatch()->onQueue('high')->onConnection('redis'); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.overrides {"queue":"high","connection":"redis"}
            dispatch(new ProcessOrder)->delay(60)->afterCommit(); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.overrides {"delay":60,"after_commit":true}
            Mail::to('a@example.com')->locale('es')->send(new OrderReceipt); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.overrides.locale es
            Mail::mailer('postmark')->to('a@example.com')->send(new OrderReceipt); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.overrides.mailer postmark
            Mail::to('a@example.com')->send((new OrderReceipt)->mailer('postmark')); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.overrides.mailer postmark

            ProcessOrder::dispatch()->delay(now()->addMinutes(5)); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.overrides null
            ProcessOrder::dispatch()->delay($seconds); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.overrides null

            $job = new ProcessOrder;
            $job->onQueue('high');
            dispatch($job); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.overrides null
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Classes passed to a method that dispatches its parameter"

    ```php title="app/Services/Messenger.php"
    namespace App\Services;

    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;

    class Messenger implements Sends
    {
        public function mail(string $mailClass, string $to): void
        {
            Mail::to($to)->send(new $mailClass); // ✗ dynamic_class_name
        }

        public function fire(object $event): void
        {
            event($event); // ✗ dynamic_class_name
        }

        public function reuse(string $mailClass): void
        {
            $mailClass = $mailClass.'Mail';
            Mail::send(new $mailClass); // ✗ dynamic_class_name
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Services/Sends.php"
    namespace App\Services;

    interface Sends
    {
        public function mail(string $mailClass, string $to): void;
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use App\Mail\OrderReceipt;
    use App\Services\Messenger;
    use App\Services\Sends;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function __construct(private Messenger $messenger, private Sends $sends) {}

        public function store(Messenger $messenger, object $anything): void
        {
            app(Messenger::class)->mail(mailClass: OrderReceipt::class, to: 'a@example.com'); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.method OrderController::store
            $this->messenger->mail(OrderReceipt::class, 'a@example.com'); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.method OrderController::store
            $messenger->fire(new OrderPlaced); // → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            $this->queue(ProcessOrder::class); // → jobs[ProcessOrder].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            $messenger->reuse(OrderReceipt::class); // ✗ not recorded
            $messenger->fire($anything); // ✗ not recorded
            $this->sends->mail(OrderReceipt::class, 'a@example.com'); // ✗ not recorded
        }

        private function queue(string $job): void
        {
            $job::dispatch(); // ✗ dynamic_class_name
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Mail\OrderReceipt;
    use App\Services\Messenger;

    class SendReceipt
    {
        public function handle(OrderPlaced $event): void
        {
            (new Messenger)->mail(OrderReceipt::class, 'a@example.com'); // → listeners[SendReceipt].dispatches.confidence low
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Targets Loom cannot name"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Events\OrderShipped;
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use Illuminate\Contracts\Bus\Dispatcher;

    class OrderController
    {
        private OrderPlaced $event;

        public function store(string $class, string $name, bool $urgent, ?OrderPlaced $placed): void
        {
            $class::dispatch(); // ✗ dynamic_class_name
            event(new $class); // ✗ dynamic_class_name
            event(app(OrderPlaced::class)); // ✗ container_resolution
            event('App\Events\\'.$name); // ✗ string_concatenation
            event($urgent ? new OrderShipped : $placed); // ✗ conditional_dispatch
            event($this->makeEvent()); // ✗ call_result
            event($this->event); // ✗ stored_target
            event($placed ?? new OrderPlaced); // ✗ unsupported_expression
            app(Dispatcher::class)->dispatch(new ProcessOrder); // ✗ not recorded

            event(new OrderPlaced); // → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            event(OrderPlaced::class); // → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method OrderController::store
            event('App\Events\OrderPlaced'); // ✗ string_event_name
        }

        private function makeEvent(): OrderPlaced
        {
            return new OrderPlaced;
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Sending mail"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Mail\OrderReceipt;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function store(object $mailable, array $data): void
        {
            Mail::send(new OrderReceipt); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.method OrderController::store
            Mail::sendNow(new OrderReceipt); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.method OrderController::store
            Mail::queue(new OrderReceipt); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.method OrderController::store
            Mail::later(60, new OrderReceipt); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.method OrderController::store
            Mail::to('a@example.com')->cc('b@example.com')->bcc('c@example.com')->send(new OrderReceipt); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.method OrderController::store
            Mail::to('a@example.com')->queue(new OrderReceipt); // → mailables[OrderReceipt].sent_from.method OrderController::store

            Mail::send($mailable); // ✗ dynamic_class_name

            Mail::raw('Shipped', fn ($message) => $message->to('a@example.com')); // ✗ view_mail
            Mail::html('<p>Shipped</p>', fn ($message) => $message->to('a@example.com')); // ✗ view_mail
            Mail::plain('emails.shipped', $data, fn ($message) => $message->to('a@example.com')); // ✗ view_mail
            Mail::mailer('ses')->raw('Shipped', fn ($message) => $message->to('a@example.com')); // ✗ view_mail
        }
    }
    ```

# Schedule

??? example "Tasks in routes/console.php"

    ```php title="routes/console.php"
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule;

    Schedule::command('reports:send')->dailyAt('3:15'); // → scheduled_tasks.kind command → scheduled_tasks.cron 15 3 * * *
    Schedule::job(new ProcessOrder)->everyFiveMinutes(); // → scheduled_tasks.target App\Jobs\ProcessOrder → scheduled_tasks.cron */5 * * * *
    Schedule::call(fn () => null)->hourly(); // → scheduled_tasks.kind closure → scheduled_tasks.target null
    Schedule::exec('node prune.js')->cron('0 4 * * 1'); // → scheduled_tasks.kind exec → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 4 * * 1
    Schedule::command('invoices:send')->daysOfMonth(1, 15); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 0 1,15 * *
    Schedule::command('taxes:file')->quarterlyOn(10, '8:00'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 8 10 1-12/3 *
    Schedule::command('queue:work')->everyTenSeconds(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron null → scheduled_tasks.frequency {"every":10,"unit":"seconds"}

    Artisan::command('carts:prune {--days=}', fn () => null)->daily(); // → scheduled_tasks.target carts:prune
    ```

??? example "Groups, conditions and constraints"

    ```php title="routes/console.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule;

    Schedule::daily()->onOneServer()->group(function () {
        Schedule::command('reports:send'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 0 * * * → scheduled_tasks.on_one_server true
        Schedule::command('reports:archive')->hourly(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 * * * *
    });

    if (app()->isProduction()) {
        Schedule::command('backup:run')->daily()->weekdays()->between('1:00', '5:00')->withoutOverlapping(); // → scheduled_tasks.constraints if(\app()->isProduction()) → scheduled_tasks.constraints weekdays → scheduled_tasks.without_overlapping true
    }

    Schedule::command('cache:warm')->hourly()->environments('production')->when(fn () => true); // → scheduled_tasks.constraints when(closure)
    Schedule::command('queue:prune')->hourly()->timezone('Europe/Paris')->runInBackground(); // → scheduled_tasks.timezone Europe/Paris → scheduled_tasks.run_in_background true
    ```

??? example "Schedule handed to another class"

    ```php title="app/Console/Kernel.php"
    namespace App\Console;

    use App\Scheduling\BillingTasks;
    use App\Scheduling\CleanupTasks;
    use App\Scheduling\ReportTasks;
    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Console\Kernel as ConsoleKernel;

    class Kernel extends ConsoleKernel
    {
        protected ReportTasks $reports;

        protected function schedule(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            (new BillingTasks)->register($schedule);
            BillingTasks::nightly($schedule);

            (new CleanupTasks)->register($schedule);

            if (app()->isProduction()) {
                app(CleanupTasks::class)->register($schedule);
            }

            if (config('cleanup.staging')) {
                resolve(CleanupTasks::class)->register($schedule);
            }

            $this->reports->register($schedule); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Scheduling/BillingTasks.php"
    namespace App\Scheduling;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;

    class BillingTasks
    {
        public function register(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('invoices:charge')->daily(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 0 * * *
            $this->reminders($schedule);
        }

        public static function nightly(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('invoices:close')->dailyAt('23:00'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 23 * * *
        }

        private function reminders(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('invoices:remind')->hourly(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 * * * *
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Scheduling/CleanupTasks.php"
    namespace App\Scheduling;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;

    class CleanupTasks
    {
        public function register(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('logs:prune')->weekly(); // → scheduled_tasks.constraints [] → scheduled_tasks.constraints ["if(app()->isProduction())"] → scheduled_tasks.constraints ["if(config('cleanup.staging'))"]
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Scheduling/ReportTasks.php"
    namespace App\Scheduling;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;

    {
        public function register(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
    ```

    ```php title="app/Scheduling/QueueTasks.php"
    namespace App\Scheduling;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;

    class QueueTasks
    {
        public function __invoke(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->job(new \App\Jobs\ProcessOrder)->everyFiveMinutes(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron */5 * * * *
        }

    ```

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    use App\Scheduling\QueueTasks;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;

    return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
        ->withSchedule(new QueueTasks)
        ->create();
    ```

??? example "Console kernel and withSchedule"

    ```php title="app/Console/Kernel.php"
    namespace App\Console;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Console\Kernel as ConsoleKernel;

    class Kernel extends ConsoleKernel
    {
        protected function schedule(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('reports:send')->weekly()->at('9:30'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 30 9 * * 0
            $this->billing($schedule);
        }

        private function billing(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('invoices:charge')->monthlyOn(1, '6:00'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 6 1 * *
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;

    return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
        ->withSchedule(function (Schedule $schedule) {
            $schedule->command('carts:prune')->daily(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 0 * * *
        })
        ->create();
    ```

??? example "Frequencies Loom cannot turn into cron"

    ```php title="routes/console.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule;

    $time = config('reports.time');

    Schedule::command('reports:send')->dailyAt($time); // → scheduled_tasks.cron null
    Schedule::command('reports:archive')->everyFifteenMinutes()->myMacro(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron null
    ```

# Routes

??? example "Routes declared with attributes"

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/PhotoController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use Spatie\RouteAttributes\Attributes\Get;

    class PhotoController
    {
        #[Get('/photos')] // ✗ attribute_route
        public function index(): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Dispatches from a route's action"

    ```php title="routes/web.php"
    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Http\Controllers\OrderController;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::post('/orders', [OrderController::class, 'store']);

    Route::post('/orders/{order}/ship', function () {
        event(new OrderPlaced); // → routes[/orders/{order}/ship].dispatches.target OrderPlaced → events[OrderPlaced].dispatched_from.method POST /orders/{order}/ship
    });
    ```

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;

    class OrderController
    {
        public function store(): void
        {
            ProcessOrder::dispatch(); // → routes[/orders].dispatches.target ProcessOrder
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Groups, chains and middleware"

    ```php title="routes/web.php"
    use App\Http\Controllers\OrderController;
    use App\Http\Middleware\Audit;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::middleware('auth')->prefix('v1')->name('v1.')->get('/orders', [OrderController::class, 'index'])->name('orders'); // → routes.uri /v1/orders → routes.name v1.orders → routes.middleware ["auth"]

    Route::prefix('admin')->middleware('web')->middleware(['auth', 'verified'])->controller(OrderController::class)->group(function () {
        Route::get('/orders', 'index'); // → routes.uri /admin/orders → routes.middleware ["auth","verified"] → routes.controller_method index

        Route::middleware('throttle:10,1')->group(function () {
            Route::get('/exports', 'export')->middleware(Audit::class.':strict')->withoutMiddleware('verified'); // → routes.middleware ["auth","throttle:10,1","App\\Http\\Middleware\\Audit:strict"]
        });
    });
    ```

??? example "Resource and singleton routes"

    ```php title="routes/web.php"
    use App\Http\Controllers\PhotoController;
    use App\Http\Controllers\ProfileController;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::resource('photos', PhotoController::class)->only(['index', 'update']); // → routes[/photos].name photos.index → routes[/photos/{photo}].method PUT → routes[/photos/{photo}].method PATCH
    Route::apiResource('photos.comments', PhotoController::class)->only('show'); // → routes[/photos/{photo}/comments/{comment}].name photos.comments.show
    Route::resource('admin/user-photos', PhotoController::class)->only('show'); // → routes[/admin/user-photos/{user_photo}].name user-photos.show
    Route::resource('albums', PhotoController::class)->except(['create', 'edit', 'destroy'])->names(['index' => 'albums.all']); // → routes[/albums].name albums.all
    Route::singleton('profile', ProfileController::class); // → routes[/profile].name profile.show → routes[/profile/edit].name profile.edit
    Route::apiResources(['posts' => PhotoController::class]); // → routes[/posts].name posts.index
    ```

??? example "Route files loaded by the app"

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;

    return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
        ->withRouting(
            web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
            api: __DIR__.'/../routes/api.php',
        )
        ->create();
    ```

    ```php title="routes/web.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::get('/orders', fn () => null); // → routes.middleware ["web"]

    Route::middleware('auth')->group(function () {
        require __DIR__.'/account.php';
    });
    ```

    ```php title="routes/account.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::get('/account', fn () => null); // → routes.middleware ["web","auth"]
    ```

    ```php title="routes/api.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::get('/orders', fn () => null); // → routes.uri /api/orders → routes.middleware ["api"]
    ```

    ```php title="app/Providers/BillingServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class BillingServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function boot(): void
        {
            $this->loadRoutesFrom(base_path('modules/billing/routes.php'));
            Route::prefix('admin')->group(app_path('Admin/routes.php'));
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="modules/billing/routes.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::get('/invoices', fn () => null); // → routes.uri /invoices
    ```

    ```php title="app/Admin/routes.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::get('/reports', fn () => null); // → routes.uri /admin/reports
    ```

??? example "View, redirect and fallback routes"

    ```php title="routes/web.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::view('/about', 'pages.about'); // → routes.kind view → routes.method GET
    Route::redirect('/home', '/dashboard'); // → routes.kind redirect → routes.method ANY
    Route::permanentRedirect('/start', '/dashboard'); // → routes.kind redirect
    Route::fallback(fn () => abort(404)); // → routes.kind fallback → routes.uri /{fallbackPlaceholder}
    ```

??? example "Route files Loom cannot follow"

    ```php title="app/Providers/RouteServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class RouteServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function boot(string $module): void
        {
            $this->loadRoutesFrom(base_path("modules/{$module}/routes.php")); // ✗ route_file_dynamic
            $this->loadRoutesFrom('routes/admin.php'); // ✗ route_file_relative
            $this->loadRoutesFrom(__DIR__.'/../../../shared/routes.php'); // ✗ route_file_outside_root
            Route::group([], base_path('modules/missing/routes.php')); // ✗ route_file_not_found
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Routes Loom cannot read"

    ```php title="routes/web.php"
    use App\Http\Controllers\PhotoController;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    $uri = '/photos';
    $verbs = ['get', 'post'];
    $name = 'photos';
    $only = ['index'];
    $middleware = ['auth'];
    $prefix = 'v2';

    Route::inertia('/about', 'About'); // ✗ unknown_route_call
    Route::get($uri, [PhotoController::class, 'index']); // ✗ dynamic_uri
    Route::match($verbs, '/search', [PhotoController::class, 'search']); // ✗ dynamic_verbs
    Route::resource($name, PhotoController::class); // ✗ dynamic_resource
    Route::resource('albums', PhotoController::class)->only($only); // ✗ dynamic_resource_options → routes[/albums/{album}/edit].name albums.edit
    Route::get('/tags', [PhotoController::class, 'tags'])->middleware($middleware); // ✗ dynamic_middleware

    Route::prefix($prefix)->group(function () { // ✗ dynamic_group_attribute
        Route::get('/feed', [PhotoController::class, 'feed']);
    });
    ```

??? example "Verbs and actions"

    ```php title="routes/web.php"
    use App\Http\Controllers\OrderController;
    use App\Http\Controllers\ShowDashboard;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

    Route::get('/orders', [OrderController::class, 'index'])->name('orders.index'); // → routes.controller_method index → routes.name orders.index
    Route::post('/orders', 'App\Http\Controllers\OrderController@store'); // → routes.method POST → routes.controller_method store
    Route::put('/orders/{order}', [OrderController::class, 'update']); // → routes.method PUT
    Route::patch('/orders/{order}', [OrderController::class, 'update']); // → routes.method PATCH
    Route::delete('/orders/{order}', [OrderController::class, 'destroy']); // → routes.method DELETE
    Route::options('/orders', [OrderController::class, 'options']); // → routes.method OPTIONS
    Route::any('/ping', [OrderController::class, 'ping']); // → routes.method ANY
    Route::match(['get', 'post'], '/search', [OrderController::class, 'search']); // → routes.method GET → routes.method POST
    Route::get('/dashboard', ShowDashboard::class); // → routes.controller_fqcn App\Http\Controllers\ShowDashboard → routes.controller_method __invoke
    Route::get('/health', fn () => 'ok'); // → routes.controller_fqcn null
    ```

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    class OrderController {}
    ```

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/ShowDashboard.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    class ShowDashboard
    {
        public function __invoke(): void {}
    }
    ```
